 The NBA Cup is in full swing, and the Celtics will continue tournament play against the Hornets on Friday night.
 Boston won its first NBA Cup game on Oct. 30, beating Chicago in Group C action. The Celtics are coming off a 109-102 win over the Bucks in which Paul George scored a team-high 25 points.
 WATCH:
 Celtics vs. Hornets LIVE on Fubo (free trial) 
 The Hornets fell to the Wizards in their NBA Cup opener last week. After a 3-1 start to the 2026-27 season, Charlotte has lost five straight games.
 Here is everything you need to know about Celtics vs. Hornets, including TV and streaming options for the NBA Cup game.
 How to watch Celtics vs. Hornets tonight: TV channel, live stream
 TV channel: NBC Sports Boston
 Live stream: Fubo 
 Celtics vs. Hornets will air on NBC Sports Boston. The game can also be streamed on  Fubo .

 Celtics vs. Hornets date, start time
 Date:  Friday, Nov. 6
 Time:  7 p.m. ET
 Celtics vs. Hornets is scheduled to start at 7 p.m. ET on Friday, Nov. 6. The game will be played at the Spectrum Center in Charlotte, N.C.
